reason: Published LAME already performs output-level graph adaptation without network updates. Generic graph smoothing is a relevant external comparator, not our novel mechanism.
code_license: CC BY-NC-SA4.0; attribution/license URL retained in the adapter; NumPy/SciPy CPU port and tie changes explicitly marked.
hyperparameter_origin: Published AppendixC.1 and official overall_best k=5; no target GT or core HOTA tuning.
task_adapter: For each current-video query, candidates form a binary member/nonmember batch. Track IDs/boxes preserved, independent per-query decoder. CPU float64; explicit self exclusion/stable Track-ID ties.

comparators.RAW_LAME_KNN5: RAW_FINAL ordinary teacher head,768D sourcePCD kernel.
comparators.DS_RGB_LAME_KNN5: DS_FINAL same evidence head,1081D PCD+query-conditionedRGB+sameappearancecue kernel; stronger explicit visual information comparator.

interpretation: Compare FULL separately to each; differences between the two baselines change both head and feature map, so are not reliability/feature-only attribution. Original classification benchmark is not reproduced.
GT_barrier: All162supplement predictions sealed before supplement GT; wait core analysis first. Core468 remains a separate GT group.
reused_count_algorithm: Immutable core independent count algorithm with local constants in isolated processes;7variants including allself-controls.
evaluation: All6settings x seeds0/17/42, unchanged official HOTA and both CountMatched rankings; KITTI4 no populationCI. No posthoc comparator promotion or suppression of negative results.
